commentary.text: 90+12' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+11' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Caoimhin Kelleher.
90+11' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
90+10' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Igor Thiago (Brentford) is given a yellow card.
90+10' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+7' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) works the corner short.

90+7' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Brentford will have a corner.
90+6' Keith Andrews has decided to substitute Dango Ouattara and he is replaced by Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
90+6' Substitution. Rico Henry (Brentford) in, Kristoffer Ajer out.
90+4' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90+4' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+3' 4:3 – the corner kicks stats.
90+1' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+1' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Brentford win a corner.
90' Igor Thiago (Brentford) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.

89' 3 - 2 Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) meets a perfect cross from Dominik Szoboszlai deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the back of the net via the crossbar. The score is 3:2.
88' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
84' Keane Lewis-Potter delivers a perfect cross for Dango Ouattara (Brentford), who has simple job scoring from close range but somehow contrives to send the ball just wide of the right post.
83' That will be all from Florian Wirtz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Joe Gomez (Liverpool).
83' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
79' Keith Andrews decides to make a substitution. Mikkel Damsgaard will be replaced by Mathias Jensen (Brentford).
79' Substitution. Kevin Schade makes his way off the pitch and Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) comes on as his replacement.
78' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is about to take a corner kick.

77' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
76' Kevin Schade (Brentford) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
74' The foul by Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) was seen by Tim Robinson who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
72' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared.
71' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and Liverpool manage to earn a corner.
70' 15:10 – the total goal attempt statistics. 8:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
70' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Curtis Jones.
69' Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
68' Igor Thiago (Brentford) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
67' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) sends the corner into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts it and averts the threat.
67' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Brentford win a corner kick.
66' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
65' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
65' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
63' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
62' Arne Slot prepares a substitution. Conor Bradley is replaced by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool).
61' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) replaces Milos Kerkez.
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) coming on for Cody Gakpo.
60' 3 - 1 Goal! Igor Thiago (Brentford) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty low past Giorgi Mamardashvili into the middle of the goal.
60' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
60' The Brentford players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
59' There's a break in play and referee Tim Robinson must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Brentford using VAR. This could be interesting!
57' The referee is firm and issues Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) a deserved yellow card.
57' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and signals a foul after Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) brought his opponent down. Brentford have a free kick from a promising distance.
55' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!

55' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) serves up a nice cross, but Giorgi Mamardashvili punches the ball away. Dango Ouattara (Brentford) gets to the rebound but blows his chance to score with a header from a dangerous position inside the box. His effort floats high over the bar.
54' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

54' Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a great save to deny Igor Thiago (Brentford), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
51' Great save! Igor Thiago (Brentford) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Giorgi Mamardashvili.
50' Kevin Schade (Brentford) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
47' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' 2 - 1 Goal! Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 2:1.
45+2' Kevin Schade (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' 2 - 0 GOAL! Kevin Schade (Brentford) runs onto a pass from Mikkel Damsgaard after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 2:0.
44' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
44' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
41' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
40' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

39' The ball is cleared after Igor Thiago (Brentford) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the roof of the net. It would have probably ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Giorgi Mamardashvili and his brilliant save.
38' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.
35' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
34' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Jordan Henderson (Brentford), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) was quite harsh and Simon Hooper didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

32' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
32' Michael Kayode (Brentford) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
31' 3:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.

30' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Giorgi Mamardashvili displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
29' Problems for Keith Andrews as Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Vitaly Janelt replaces him.
28' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
27' Half-chance! Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) plays a pass into the box, but Caoimhin Kelleher reacts well to snuff out the attack.
25' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
24' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
22' Cody Gakpo sets up Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) with a lofted pass in the centre of the box, but his header flies just wide of the right post.
21' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
20' This would have been a magnificent goal from Florian Wirtz (Liverpool), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the left post.
20' Neat passing move from Liverpool in order to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
16' Ball possession – 26:74.
12' Referee Simon Hooper sees the trip by Kevin Schade (Brentford) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Liverpool, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

12' A through ball from Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) fails to reach Mohamed Salah as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Mohamed Salah could have got into a promising position.

10' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Caoimhin Kelleher leaps like a salmon to deny him.
10' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) sends a long ball forward to Igor Thiago, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
9' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Caoimhin Kelleher, who smothers the ball.
7' Kevin Schade (Brentford) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
7' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and it's Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

5' 1 - 0 That's scrappy, but it's a GOAL! The long throw into the box comically bobbles around until pounced on by Dango Ouattara (Brentford), who scuffs the ball into the net from inside the six-yard box. It's now 1:0.

3' What a poor attempt! Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
3' Michael Kayode (Brentford) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
2' Liverpool are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Liverpool will have the kick-off.
Simon Hooper got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
